# Paula Magdy — Full-Stack Software Engineer

> Full-stack software engineer in Cairo, Egypt. Production experience across
> TypeScript, PHP, and Python on AWS, Azure, and Huawei Cloud.

## About
Paula Magdy has production experience across multiple stacks — TypeScript
(Next.js/NestJS), PHP (Laravel), and Python (Django/Flask) — on AWS, Azure, and
Huawei Cloud. An AWS Certified Solutions Architect, he contributes across data
modeling, API design, CI/CD, monitoring, and security on cross-functional teams
delivering government-grade and enterprise platforms that serve thousands of
concurrent users. Works at Challenge Group. Alumnus of October 6 University.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Cloud Practitioner; Huawei
HCCDP-Solution Architectures and HCCDA-Tech Essentials certified.

## Availability
Open to full-stack engineering roles and consulting engagements, including remote
work (based in Cairo, UTC+2). Typically replies within 24 hours.
